request: Read only current DebugAI running product source identity and 6-role mode; no inference, no source or runtime changes

bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
cd /home/admin1/projects/debug-ai
printf 'DEBUGAI_HOST_HEAD='
git rev-parse HEAD
printf 'DEBUGAI_HOST_DIRTY_COUNT='
git status --porcelain --untracked-files=all | wc -l
printf 'DEBUGAI_APP_IMAGE='
docker inspect -f '{{.Image}}' debug-ai-debug-ai-1
docker inspect -f '{{range .Config.Env}}{{println .}}{{end}}' debug-ai-debug-ai-1 | awk -F= '$1=="DEBUG_AI_ROLE_EXECUTION_MODE" || $1=="DEBUG_AI_CORE_GATE_DISPATCH_MODE" {print $1 "=" $2}'
